changes.source: For the past decade Anthill Ventures has redefined early stage investing by uniting speed scaling discipline with bold innovation. Across Living Healthy, Mitigating Climate Change, and Enhancing Urban Lifestyle, we help founders compress years of growth into months through capital, 100+ market access channels, and our data driven Scalability Quotient™. Our operators and domain experts craft breakthrough products, shape resilient business models, and leverage deep analytics to turn intellectual property into category leadership. We advance India’s 2030 vision while setting new global benchmarks for impact and return.
changes.replacement: We invest in early-stage companies and work with founders on funding, mentorship and market access.

changes.source: At Anthill, we accelerate innovation through speed-scaling investments. Our portfolio comprises over 80 breakthrough startups in health tech, climate solutions, urban innovation, and media across ten countries. Collectively, our portfolio companies have gone on to raise over $1 billion in follow-on capital, underscoring our drive for growth, success, and sector transformation.
changes.replacement: Anthill's portfolio includes more than 80 startups across ten countries. Together, these companies have raised over $1 billion in follow-on capital.

changes.source: To pitch your idea to Anthill, show how it aligns with living healthy, mitigating climate change or enhancing urban lifestyle, and can be speed‑scaled. Present a crisp plan with market proof, unit economics and staged projections. Demonstrate traction, a resilient team and measurable impact. Keep slides clear, concise, data‑led, and invite iterative feedback to secure our rapid engagement today.
changes.replacement: Share your pitch deck, traction, market opportunity and the team behind it. Tell us how you plan to grow and where Anthill can help.
